---
title: "Window Garden"
subtitle: "What can you grow on a sill? A friendly guide written in Quarto."
---

Almost every window can grow something. This tiny guide shows how a single plain-text file
(`.qmd`) becomes a polished website, with live charts built from small bits of code.

::: {.callout-tip}
## How to use this site
Open **Light** and drag the slider to see how many hours of sun a herb needs. Then check the
**Calendar** for when to sow.
:::

## Easy starters

| Plant | Light needed | Water |
|---|---|---|
| Mint | Part shade | Keep moist |
| Basil | 6+ hours | Every 2 days |
| Chives | 4+ hours | Weekly |
| Lettuce | 3+ hours | Keep moist |

Where do the numbers come from? Right from the page itself: Quarto can run code and show
the result next to your words.

```{ojs}
//| echo: true
plants = [
  {name: "Mint", hours: 3}, {name: "Basil", hours: 6},
  {name: "Chives", hours: 4}, {name: "Lettuce", hours: 3}
]
html`<p><b>${plants.length} plants</b>, needing ${d3.min(plants, d => d.hours)} to ${d3.max(plants, d => d.hours)} hours of sun.</p>`
```
